summary: Scoped regression test for STORE-PREP-001 (2 changes only, per explicit instruction — no general sweep). Logged in as voicetest2026@example.com on Expo web preview (390x844). ITEM 1 (ipc-bns-lookup disclaimer banner): PASS. DisclaimerBanner (testID=ipc-bns-disclaimer) is rendered outside the ScrollView, directly inside the SafeAreaView, with style flexShrink:0 — confirmed fixed at bbox {x:0,y:783,w:390,h:61} both before any search, after an IPC section search ('302'), and after scrolling the results list with mouse.wheel(0,800) — bbox identical before/after scroll, banner always visible, text renders correctly ('DHARA provides legal information, not legal advice...'). ITEM 2 (missing/attachments locate button): code at /app/frontend/app/missing/attachments.tsx locate() correctly checks getForegroundPermissionsAsync -> requestForegroundPermissionsAsync -> if still not granted: if !canAskAgain shows Alert.alert('Location permission needed', ..., [Cancel, Open Settings->Linking.openSettings()]); else throws a generic Error caught and shown inline. Tested (a) GRANTED permission (context.grant_permissions + set_geolocation 19.0760,72.8777): clicking 'Use my current GPS' worked, candidate coordinates rendered correctly in missing-location-confirmation, no crash. (b) DENIED permission (overrode navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition to error+navigator.permissions.query to 'denied'): app showed the generic inline error 'Location permission was denied. Enter coordinates below or continue without GPS.' with no crash — page remained fully interactive. LIMITATION: the canAskAgain=false / Alert('Open Settings') branch could NOT be exercised in the web preview because expo-location's web shim (node_modules/expo-location/src/ExpoLocation.web.ts getPermissionsAsync) hardcodes canAskAgain: true for both GRANTED and DENIED states on web — this branch is only reachable on a native Android/iOS build where the OS reports permanent denial. Code review confirms the conditional logic itself (if (!permission.canAskAgain) { Alert.alert(...) }) is correctly implemented and would fire on-device; this is a web-platform testing limitation, not a defect found.
action_items: No code changes required for the two reviewed items — both behave as specified.

INFO ONLY: The 'permanently denied -> Alert with Open Settings' path (item 2b) cannot be verified on Expo web preview due to expo-location's web shim always returning canAskAgain:true; recommend a quick manual check on a physical Android device/emulator before Play Closed Testing submission to visually confirm the Alert dialog renders and 'Open Settings' deep-links correctly, since this is the only untestable sub-case here.
critical_code_review_comments: ipc-bns-lookup.tsx: DisclaimerBanner correctly placed as a sibling after the KeyboardAvoidingView/ScrollView (not inside it), with flexShrink:0 in its own styles — guarantees it never scrolls with content. Implementation is correct.

missing/attachments.tsx locate(): permission-state branching (granted / denied-with-canAskAgain / denied-without-canAskAgain) is structured correctly and wrapped in try/catch/finally so busy state is always cleared — no risk of a stuck 'Please wait' spinner or crash in any state.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the two in-scope items verified; item 2b alert-dialog sub-case not exercisable on web (platform limitation, not a failure)
